answer: We enforce Sybil resistance through a recursive zero-knowledge architecture where agents prove identity uniqueness by binding staking collateral to a verifiable delay function. An adversary attempting to forge identities faces exponential slashing penalties that reduce the expected attack utility below zero, extinguishing any malicious ember of profit. This cryptoeconomic design reaches its zenith of security when the falcon signature scheme, coupled with sequential delay steps, forces a robust Nash equilibrium.
